newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CESI index rises slightly to end 1,434.59 points.
newsitem.headline: CESI index rises slightly to end 1,434.59 points.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index rose 6.98 points or 0.49 percent to 1,434.59 points on Thursday, said the Budapest Stock Exchange.
The index reflects trends of 72 Hungarian, Polish, Czech, Slovak and Slovenian shares.
